# `company.shipment_packages`

Immutable boxes of a draft or shipment revision.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this package row. |
| `shipment_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_shipment_packages_shipment | — | Draft or shipment (one id: the shipment keeps its draft's). |

| `tracking_number` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Tracking number of this box, as text; null when blank. |
